blurb: Guests can explore the distillery with a guided tour and tasting of Burwood's spirits. They can also participate in a whisky cask blending class to create a custom blend. The distillery offers a variety of hand-crafted spirits and seasonal gins for purchase.
extraNote: No refunds or reschedules within 14 days of scheduled tour · Orders require adult signature and ID of legal drinking age · Returns accepted within 7 days if unopened and in original packaging with receipt
